QuestInfo.name: Delivering Nutritious Juice to Shanks
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2103##k seems to need your help again.
QuestInfo.1: #p2103# asked you to give nutritious juice to #b#p22000##k, the captain of #b#m60000##k. Hmm... Are they dating?
QuestInfo.2: You gave #p22000# #p2103#'s nutritious juice. #p22000# looked happy...#p2103# and #p22000# are dating. The juice looks...pretty nasty, actually, but #p22000# seemed happy.

0.0: I'm sorry to ask you for help again but I'm lucky to meet a kind adventurer like you. Can you do me a favor?

yes.0: Ah! Thank you! I'm so glad to have a nice person like you in Maple World. Can you give this complete #b#t04031556##k to #b#p22000##k. He is a captain in #b#m60000##k. You can't miss him. Thank you.

no.0: Well. I've already asked two things. I've been annoying, haven't I?

1.0: Huh? What the matter? Ah. This is #p2103#'s special nutritious juice. Did #p2103# send you here? Thank you very much! It's a great pleasure to have a nice partner.

yes.0: Now, you are ready to take an adventure. Would you like to go to a new world? Once on board, I can show you #bVictoria Island#k. Once you leave, you can't come back though. What do you say?

npc.0: You haven't found #b#p22000##k yet. He's a captain in #b#m60000##k.

item.0: What's the matter? I'm willing to take you, if you're ready to leave Maple Island and start your adventure elsewhere!

lost.0: What? You lost the nutritious juice! I'll give you more as I made some for you as well. But don't lose it.
